column1: # gate-bypass.tsv - operator-recorded bypasses of the reviewer-eval merge gate (HIMMEL-9259).
# One row per bypass, four TAB-separated columns:
#   pr <TAB> head sha prefix (7 to 40 lowercase hex; a new row writes the full 40-hex head) <TAB> decision id <TAB> reason
# scripts/ci/check-critic-eval.sh reads this file at the default branch's tip as CI's checkout holds it (else at
# the diff base), never from the PR's own tree, so a PR cannot add its own row.
# A row is honoured only for its PR number at its head; a malformed row fails the gate closed.
# A row lands by a chief-ruled change of its own, citing the operator decision in column 3.
